name: UO KeeperFX Vita
author: DannyDLux90
description:
UO KeeperFX Vita is a PlayStation Vita port of KeeperFX, the open-source engine recreation and enhancement project for Bullfrog's Dungeon Keeper.
The port adapts KeeperFX for native execution on PlayStation Vita hardware and includes Vita-specific rendering, input, audio, video playback, storage and platform integration.
This port is not affiliated with the KeeperFX team.
